domain_description: Teach students to plan, monitor, and evaluate their own learning — through metacognitive prompts, scaffolds, study-strategy guidance, self-explanation, and if-then implementation intentions. All interventions cross-referenced to peer-reviewed meta-analyses where one exists.

skills.description: Build a library of metacognitive prompts that target planning ("What's my goal here?"), monitoring ("Is this working?"), or evaluation ("What worked, what didn't?") — so students develop the habit of asking themselves the right cognitive question at the right moment.
skills.effect_months_source: EEF Toolkit — Metacognition and self-regulation strand
skills.implementation_cost_rationale: Building a prompt library is a one-time prep job — 20-30 prompts cover most tasks; reusable across cohorts. In-lesson use takes seconds (display a prompt, give think time). No materials beyond the prompt list, no training beyond awareness.
